description: Discovers which MCU parts and which PlatformSDK / RTD versions the installed NXP S32 Configuration Tools MCU data package actually supports, so the `mcu`, `sdk_version` and `platform_sdk` arguments required by configure, GTM and the other lookup actions can be resolved instead of guessed. Triggers on "which MCUs are available", "what parts does S32CT support", "list installed MCUs", "which SDK / RTD / PlatformSDK versions for S32K344", "what sdk_version should I use", "is S32G274A installed", "enumerate processors folder", or any cold-start where the user has no `.mex` yet and needs a legal `mcu` / `sdk_version` before an `empty_config` bootstrap or `s32ct.gtm_create_from_usecase`. Read-only; reads the `processors/` folder of the MCU data package and never launches the tool.
